name: Spark
description: A small rocket built for small satellites. Cheap and flexible, but it cannot go beyond low orbits.

name: Rideshare Slot
classNote: shared ride on a medium rocket, SSO only, max 300 kg
description: Book a seat on a medium rocket together with other satellites. Very cheap per kilogram, but only to sun-synchronous orbit and only when the shared rocket flies (every 4 months).

name: Arrow
description: A light-medium launcher that can reach the Moon or Mars with small spacecraft. A good middle option when every dollar counts.

name: Workhorse
description: A reliable, reusable medium-lift rocket. The default choice for most missions — affordable and flies often.

name: Titan
description: A heavy-lift rocket for big observatories and deep-space missions. Powerful and expensive.
